methodology: Initial nationwide source registry populated from the repository's actual collector scripts, data files, and source-health records, cross-checked against current official government pages as of 2026-08-16. Every row marked collector_status=live or snapshot with property_query=true corresponds to a collector script that produces individually identified, verified records. Rows marked not_started or identified are honest placeholders, not fabricated coverage — a county or state only changes to property_query=true once tested, executable collector code exists and produces validated individual records.

definitions.property_query_true: Executable collector code produces one verified row per certificate, parcel, sale item, or property.
definitions.property_query_false: Only informational/market rows, links, schedules, or an unimplemented/blocked source exist.

jurisdictions.blocker: Occasional collector-side read timeouts fetching the county PDF; the collector retains the prior verified 91 rows on any failed attempt rather than publishing zero.
